articles.title: Why Fluence Energy Stock Is Skyrocketing On Monday?
articles.teaser: Fluence Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC) stock skyrocketed over 51% Monday. Learn how its new AI factory partnership with Siemens and NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ: NVDA) is driving the rally.
articles.body:
Fluence Energy Inc. (NASDAQ:FLNC) surged over 51% on Monday following a joint announcement from Siemens AG (OTC:SMAWF) regarding a high-profile partnership with NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) to develop specialized AI data center infrastructure.

The NVIDIA Vera Rubin Reference Design

According to Siemens, the companies developed an NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin-aligned reference design.

The architecture translates NVIDIA’s AI factory vision into a deployable, industrialized electrical, power, and controls solution targeted at hyperscalers and specialized cloud infrastructure providers.

The system is sized at a total facility capacity of 136 MW with an IT load of 100 MW.

Fluence Smartstack Provides Grid Resilience

As part of the blueprint, Fluence’s battery energy storage delivers the necessary flexibility and resilience for power-constrained environments.

“Our Smartstack platform is central to this new architecture, transforming the grid into an accelerator for compute,” stated Jeff Monday, Fluence Chief Growth Officer. “By providing essential capabilities like voltage and frequency ride through, black start, grid demand response, and AI load smoothing, we are enabling our customers to build the AI factories of the future, faster and more reliably.”

Addressing Extreme Thermal Management

The design incorporates electrical parameters aligned with nVent Electric plc (NYSE:NVT) to ensure compatibility with heavy NVIDIA workloads.

“Platforms like NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 are pushing rack densities well beyond what traditional air-cooled infrastructure can support,” noted Sara Zawoyski, President of nVent Systems Protection, highlighting the necessity of deployable thermal solutions.

Technical Analysis

FLNC is trading well above its major trend gauges, sitting 45.9% above the 20-day SMA ($19.25) and 66.5% above the 200-day SMA ($16.87), which underscores how aggressive this upswing has become.

That said, the longer-term trend picture still carries some baggage because the 50-day SMA remains below the 200-day SMA (a death cross that formed in April), even as the 20-day SMA is above the 50-day SMA (a bullish near-term alignment).

RSI is the cleaner momentum read right now, and at 51.18, it’s neutral.

FLNC Price Action: Fluence Energy shares were up 50.79% at $28.47 at the time of publication on Monday, according to Benzinga Pro data.

articles.title: Optimum Communications, Fluence Energy, Virgin Galactic And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher Today
articles.teaser: Several stocks, including Optimum Communications Services, surged while Dow fell. Technology, energy, and aerospace stocks saw notable gains.
articles.body:
U.S. stocks traded lower during today's session, with the Dow falling more than 65 points on Monday. However, several technology, energy, and aerospace stocks posted notable gains.

Shares of Optimum Communications Services Inc. (NYSE:OPTU) rose sharply to lead the list of top percentage gainers.  The company announced a tender offer to buy back up to 120 million of its shares at $2.50 per share.

The buyback represents about 42.5% of the issued and outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock as of May 27, 2026. The tender offer will expire at 5:00 pm (ET) on June 30, 2026.

Optimum Communications Services surged 93.71% to $1.27 on Monday.

Here are some other big stocks recording gains in today’s session.

  • Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLNC) jumped 34.58% to $25.41.
  • Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:SPCE) gained 28.80% to $7.96, continuing the strong upward momentum from late last week. Stock market traders are rapidly accumulating positions in the space tourism pioneer, driven by several high-profile catalysts.
  • The Elmet Group Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:ELMT) climbed 25.0% to $19.10. The company reported strong first quarter earnings, with revenue up 20.7% to $56 million.
  • Taylor Morrison Home Corporation (NYSE:TMHC) advanced 22.46% to $71.64, following the announcement that Berkshire Hathaway has agreed to acquire the company in a $6.8 billion deal.
  • Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:EWTX) rose 14.72% to $39.19, after the company announced the sale of its muscular dystrophy business to Servier for $2.65 billion.
  • Arm Holdings plc (NASDAQ:ARM) gained 13.63% to $401.47, after Nvidia unveiled its new RTX Spark chip, based on Arm Holdings' designs.
  • Replimune Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:REPL) climbed 13.0% to $9.82. The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) prioritized the resubmission of the company's experimental advanced melanoma drug, RP1.
  • AirJoule Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ:AIRJ) advanced 12.9% to $5.07.
  • Asana, Inc. (NYSE:ASAN) rose 12.85% to $8.69.
